provenance.description: Isolated collision-enabled maximum-stroke tool approach; canonical controller and actual seat gate. No insertion or fastening.
limitations: Concept robot dimensions, masses, friction and controller gains are design assumptions, not a validated machine.
Rail clamps are switched ideal weld constraints with measured capture gating; clamp tooth engagement, pad compliance and structural rail strength are not resolved.
Body raising and one grip release/reacquisition are simulated; repeated storey-to-storey locomotion is not implemented.

The crane carrier follows a prescribed trajectory; unilateral spring-damper sling tensions (30 kN/m, 1.2 kNs/m, 1.4m unstretched length) and the beam rigid-body motion are simulated. Crane drive dynamics are not modeled.
Physical seat contact and guarded sling release are simulated. Bolt insertion, thread engagement, bolt preload and connection certification are NOT simulated.
The tool uses a bounded prismatic motor; it approaches the connection without tool/bolt contact. This is a partial beam-placement cycle, not completed fastening.
The workcell uses rigid seats and an I-section compound collision shape; tower flexibility is analyzed separately and is not coupled back into MuJoCo.
provenance.coordinateConversion: MuJoCo/Blender Z-up to glTF Y-up: p=(x,z,-y); Rg=C Rm C^T. MuJoCo wxyz quaternions exported xyzw.

phases.label: Rail lock preload
phases.description: Four ideal locks support the articulated chassis under gravity.

phases.label: Actuated body raise
phases.description: Bounded shoulder and elbow torques raise the chassis against fixed rail grips.

phases.label: Three-support grip cycle
phases.description: Front-left grip releases, articulates under motor torque and reacquires its original capture site; this is not a full walking gait.

phases.label: Receive suspended beam
phases.description: Prescribed crane carrier lowers a free rigid beam through tension-only spring-damper slings.

phases.label: Seat and verify support
phases.description: Two real collision seat reactions must carry the beam before sling release.

phases.label: Connection tool approach
phases.description: Tool actuator approaches the seated member. Bolt insertion and preload are still outstanding.
